text:
eli: Morning team — quick async standup. Kicking off KMS inventory sweep today and a small vuln follow-up. TL;DR: will run key inventory, validate rotation windows, and file one low-sev remediation ticket.

jess: thanks eli. can you post the inventory command you ran last time? i want to cross-check with the staging keys.

eli: sure — running this in staging:```bash
aws kms list-keys --profile redwood-staging --region us-west-2
aws kms describe-key --key-id <KEY_ID> --profile redwood-staging
```

karim: noticed one service principal with old perms (svc-legacy-ingest). i left a comment on the PR that reduces iam:PassRole scope.

sam: PR link? i can review after standup.

karim: https://git.internal/repos/security/infra/PR-482 — small IAM tighten, also updated trust policy for the ingest role.

eli: perfect. action items for today: (1) run full inventory and export CSV to /shared/sec/key-inventory/2026-03-17.csv (2) validate rotation candidates (older than 18 months) (3) open remediation ticket for the low-sev vuln (CVSS 4.3) i scanned in infra.

jess: noted. for (1) will you run with the read-only audit role or do you want me to?

eli: i'll run it now with the audit role, then push the CSV. planning to do rotation dry-run for two candidate keys at 11:15.

ops-bot: deploy status: rotation-dryrun job scheduled at 2026-03-17T11:15:00Z. See https://ops.internal/jobs/rotation-dryrun/2321 :white_check_mark:

sam: leaving a quick heads-up — SRE asked to throttle dry-run to 1 key/min to avoid load on HSMs. pls confirm in run.

eli: good catch. will set rate=1 in the script. snippet:```python
# rate limiter
for key in keys_to_rotate:
    time.sleep(60)  # 1/min
    rotate_key(key)
```

karim: also — compliance asked for a note recording who approved rotation. can we add an approval field to the ticket template?

jess: added a checklist item to the remediation ticket template: Approver, Approval Timestamp, Rollback Plan.

eli: thanks. last thing — small vuln: the package bump fixed it in staging, but i need someone to sanity-check prod rollout plan. @sam can you take that?

sam: I can. will review the change and post rollout playbook by EOD. :thumbsup:

eli: awesome. no blockers otherwise. i'll ping here after inventory run and attach the CSV. :eyes:
